bug_report: The login API fails because the user object is null before validation.

	at com.company.auth.UserRepository.findByUsername(UserRepository.java:42)

User login failed because the user object was null before validation.
similar_bugs.root_cause: The NullPointerException reported in AuthenticationService.authenticate() is the most probable cause of the observed application failure.
similar_bugs.resolution:
The issue should be resolved by addressing the identified root cause, reviewing historical resolutions, and following software engineering best practices.
Validate all user inputs before processing.
Add null and exception handling where required.
Apply the necessary code fixes and verify the changes.

similar_bugs.title: Login API Throws NullPointerException
similar_bugs.root_cause: The NullPointerException reported in UserRepository.findByUsername() is the most probable cause of the observed application failure.
similar_bugs.resolution:
Step 1: Investigate the NullPointerException in UserRepository.findByUsername() and verify that the username is not null before calling any methods on it.
Step 2: Update the UserRepository to check for null usernames and return an empty list or throw a meaningful exception if the username is null.
Step 1: Review the data storage and retrieval mechanisms in the application to ensure that usernames are consistently stored as non-null values.
Step 2: Implement validation checks at the data layer to prevent similar NullPointerExceptions in the future.
